T-003.Title: N3a Settings shell: 640 px window, 5 toolbar tabs with icons, macOS-grouped controls, per-OS styling

T-005.Title: Code-block line numbers fixed (#1648) and opt-in

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: muya renders line numbers for code blocks when codeBlockLineNumbers is on: one number per logical line, aligned with its line both with wrapping off and with wrapCodeBlocks on (a wrapped line keeps one number at its first visual row), after typing, Enter, paste, undo, font-size change and window resize; nothing rendered when off; copy and export never include the numbers.
The FIXME #1648 force-off in muya setOptions and the commented paths are replaced by the working implementation.
Default false for new profiles; a one-time migration sets a stored true to false (the key was never user-settable) and records that it ran; after it the user's choice is kept.
Tests: number count equals line count across edits; alignment (each number's top equals its line's top) with wrap on and off in a browser test; migration runs once; export/copy unaffected.

Verification.Command: npx playwright test (code block spec, chromium + webkit)
